title: The Hermit's Hoop
description: The Hermit's Hoop — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Samford the Hermit

Quest Type: Retrieve Item

Quest Description: Collect Samford's Ring from the chest next to the abandoned cart in Dew Valley 1

Quest Reward: 250 Gold

Return to: Samford the Hermit

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Locate the wrecked cart in Dew Valley Forest and recover the Hermit's Hoop. Return the ring to Samford the Hermit in Dew Valley.

Offer:

An almost special ring, just for you... but random.

Turn-in:

My ring! My precious, precious ring. I lent it to some other yahoo, but I guess that dope lost it. Thanks for returning it. Here, before you stumble back to your place in the queue, let me give you something for your troubles.

Objectives:

  • Hermit's Hoop ×1

Level range: 1–5
